Run original QfO conversion and all six assessments in a fresh short namespace with zero accession-mapping loss. Independently read raw scores and compare against the original matched canonical control. Preserve missing scores as NA until successful terminal recovery and readback.

Keep failed original jobs 24242 and 24247 and the explicit original skip. Report derived-export/scoring costs separately from the original completed inference within a failed job; do not claim uninterrupted successful full-pipeline timing or a fixed producer bug.
